response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: 'High bandwidth usage' means bandusagepct strictly greater than 47.6 (cutoff itself excluded).
Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded, and telescopes with NULL calibrstatus form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: High bandwidth usage includes the cutoff value (bandusagepct >= 47.6).
